description: This file defines a utility class for assertions in testing, specifically providing custom assertions for lists and a retry mechanism for assertions with delays. It is used in the context of testing persistence-related functionality within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: Assertions
classes.description: A final utility class providing custom assertion methods and retry mechanisms for testing persistence operations.

methods.name: assertListWithIndexInfo
methods.description: Asserts the contents of a list while providing detailed failure info including index and element details.

methods.name: retryOnAssertionError
methods.description: Retries executing a given Runnable until it succeeds or a specified timeout occurs, with delays between retries.
